design.issue: The default background is hard-coded as #2563eb instead of using the required --color-action token.
The wishlist has a hover state but no required focus outline. Its clickable span is also not keyboard-focusable.
design.fix: Render the wishlist as a button and add a :focus-visible rule with a 2px solid var(--color-focus) outline and 2px offset.

design.issue: The card's overflow: hidden clips the link's outward focus outline along the card's top and side edges.
design.fix: Keep the focus outline outside the clipping region, for example by clipping only the image rather than the whole card.

design.issue: The wishlist uses 1.125rem and the add button uses font-weight: 600, contrary to the required 1rem regular styling for everything except the product name and price.
design.fix: Use 1rem regular text for both controls while preserving the specified name and price typography.

accessibility.location: product-card.js: renderProductCard wishlist span and mountProductCard wishlist click handler; product-card.css: .product-card__wishlist
accessibility.issue: The wishlist control is a click-only span. It has no button role, descriptive accessible name, or keyboard focus/activation support. Its pointer styling does not provide these semantics. This fails WCAG 2.2 AA requirements 2.1.1 and 4.1.2.
accessibility.fix: Use a native button with type="button" and a descriptive accessible name such as "Add to wishlist". Preserve visible keyboard focus and expose aria-pressed if it toggles wishlist membership.

accessibility.issue: The product image has no alt attribute, leaving its text alternative undefined and potentially exposing its filename to screen readers. This fails WCAG 1.1.1.
accessibility.fix: Provide descriptive alt text for informative product imagery, or alt="" if the image adds nothing beyond the product name already included in the same link.
